sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

rows: The prior instruction remains valid and is still unmet: the unknown-speed branch checks Table 6-9 reference and evidence but does not bind the selected table-derived n to propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard. Locate the missing canonical lookup/result relationship or result path with the vocabulary matcher, then require that binding (and any declared table-lookup application indicator if applicable).
